title: Finite-free module inverse limits and their scalar-extension projections
statement: Let φ_n:R_(n+1)→R_n be surjective commutative-ring homomorphisms with nilpotent kernels, and let A with maps q_n be their compatible-tuple inverse limit. Let N_n be finite-free R_n-modules, u_n:N_(n+1)→N_n surjective φ_n-semilinear maps, and θ_n:N_(n+1) tensor R_n≅N_n linear isomorphisms whose scalar-extension adjoints equal u_n. Let P be an A-module with A-linear projections p_n forming a cone and satisfying the degreewise compatible-tuple existence-and-uniqueness property. Then P is finite free, and the scalar-extension adjoint of every p_n is an isomorphism. No differential or complex bound is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0CQF, finite-freeness of the terms in the compatible complex limit; compatible-basis proof

proof.text: Choose compatible coordinate equivalences e_n:N_n≃R_n^r using the compatible finite-free basis theorem. For y in P and each coordinate j the scalars e_n(p_n y)_j are compatible, so the ring-limit universal property gives a unique scalar f(y)_j in A. Uniqueness proves additivity and A-linearity coordinatewise. It also shows that f is injective from the tuple uniqueness property of P. Given a vector in A^r, its coordinatewise reductions and e_n inverse form a compatible tuple; the tuple existence property of P gives its preimage under f. Thus f is an A-linear equivalence P≃A^r, proving freeness and finiteness.

Transport the standard basis of A^r through f and that of R_n^r through e_n. Scalar extension of the former is a basis. The adjunction equation says that the adjoint of p_n sends 1 tensor each transported basis vector to the corresponding basis vector at level n. The coordinate equality q_n(f(y)_j)=e_n(p_n y)_j proves this assertion, since q_n preserves zero and one. Hence the adjoint equals the basis equivalence and is an isomorphism.

theorem finiteFree_moduleTower_inverseLimit
    (R : ℕ → Type u) [∀ n, CommRing (R n)]
    (φ : ∀ n, R (n + 1) →+* R n)
    (hsurj : ∀ n, Function.Surjective (φ n))
    (hnil : ∀ n, IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker (φ n)))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (q : ∀ n, A →+* R n)
    (hq : ∀ n, q n = (φ n).comp (q (n + 1)))
    (hlim : ∀ x : ∀ n, R n, (∀ n, φ n (x (n + 1)) = x n) →
      ∃! a : A, ∀ n, q n a = x n)
    (N : ∀ n, ModuleCat.{max u v} (R n))
    (uₙ : ∀ n, N (n + 1) ⟶ (restrictScalars (φ n)).obj (N n))
    (θₙ : ∀ n, (extendScalars (φ n)).obj (N (n + 1)) ≅ N n)
    (hterms : ∀ n, Module.Free (R n) (N n) ∧ Module.Finite (R n) (N n))
    (hsurju : ∀ n, Function.Surjective (uₙ n))
    (hθₙ : ∀ n, (extendRestrictScalarsAdj (φ n)).homEquiv
      (N (n + 1)) (N n) (θₙ n).hom = uₙ n)
    (P : ModuleCat.{max u v} A)
    (p : ∀ n, P ⟶ (restrictScalars (q n)).obj (N n))
    (hp : ∀ n (y : P), uₙ n (p (n + 1) y) = p n y)
    (hP : ∀ x : ∀ n, N n, (∀ n, uₙ n (x (n + 1)) = x n) →
      ∃! y : P, ∀ n, p n y = x n) :
    (Module.Free A P ∧ Module.Finite A P) ∧
      ∀ n, IsIso (((extendRestrictScalarsAdj (q n)).homEquiv P (N n)).symm (p n))
